title: Customer lifecycle-driven roadmap embed and release windowing
creator: Nora Chen
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable intake flow that maps customer lifecycle signals (renewal risk, usage velocity, security posture) to a constrained release windowing model so product can commit a predictable set of outcomes each quarter. Deliverables: intake form changes, scoring rubric, runway bands, and a rollout plan for the PM/CS/AE triage council.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form updated in Hub to capture lifecycle signals and weightings
Scoring rubric validated with 6 pilot customers and documented in Confluence
Release windowing policy (Green/Amber/Deferred) published and linked to roadmap lanes
Triage council runbook and SLO for response time (48h for Green/Amber classification) published
Dashboard shows signal-to-decision latency and projected Q2 slot commitments
notes: 2026-02-15: Kickoff w/ CS, Sales TF. Agreed on 3 core lifecycle signals: renewal_probability, daily_active_features, and infra_risk_score. Action: ENG to expose infra_risk_score API (ENG-2345).
2026-02-22: Design draft of compact intake form uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example. Asked DES to run 5-minute usability tests with AMs.

2026-02-28: Scoring rubric v0 assembled in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Customer+Lifecycle+Scoring. Feedback from Solutions Eng: prefer continuous weight vs buckets for renewal_probability.

2026-03-03: Trade-off discussion: strict binning reduces ambiguity for engineering commitments; continuous score improves fairness. Decision: use bins for release-windowing but store raw continuous score for downstream analytics (see decision log).
2026-03-05: Pilot sign-up: 6 customers across SMB/Enterprise agreed to trial intake flow during their Q2 planning cycles. CS owner list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/owners.
2026-03-09: First pilot intake submitted (Cust ACME Corp). Score mapped to Amber band. Action: PM to prepare scoped deliverable list for Amber band and notify dev rotas.
2026-03-11: Engineering scoping done. PR for intake API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1234 (backwards compatible), awaiting ENG review.
2026-03-12: Instrumentation: dashboard prototype for signal coverage and decision latency is at: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/customer-lifecycle. Need product metrics filter by customer tier.
2026-03-14: Triage council runbook v0 drafted and posted to Confluence. Next: align on SLA enforcement and what counts as a release slot (feature points vs effort estimate).
decision_log: Use 3 release bands: Green (fast-track), Amber (scheduled within quarter), Deferred (multi-quarter backlog).
Binning rule: renewal_probability >= 0.85 => Green, 0.6-0.85 => Amber, <0.6 => Deferred. Teams requested manual override path for security blockers.
Instrumentation decision: keep raw scores for analytics and use binned value for commitment/SLAs to keep engineering planning stable.
Security: infra_risk_score > 0.7 escalates to security review before Green classification. Security review process uses existing security-oncall rotation.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: overfitting intake to pilot customers -> Mitigation: require 6 diverse pilots before full rollout and keep manual override
Risk: CS/AE adoption friction -> Mitigation: 10-minute live training and sample email templates; track usage weekly
Risk: engineering capacity mismatch if too many Green requests -> Mitigation: cap Green slots per sprint and surface projected load in Console
